4.w: [The sons of] Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

5.w: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

6.w: And The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

7.w: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.

8.w: The sons of Ham: Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

9.w: And the sons of Cush: Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabteca. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

10.w: And Cush begat Nimrod; he began to be a mighty one on the earth.

11.w: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

12.w: and the Pathrusites, and the Casluhites (from whom came out the Philistines), and the Caphtorites.

13.w: And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,

14.w: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,

15.w: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

16.w: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

17.w: The sons of Shem: Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram. [The sons of Aram:], Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.

18.w: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.

19.w: And to Eber were born two sons. The name of one [was] Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided, and the name of his brother [was] Joktan.

20.w: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

21.w: and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,

22.w: and Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

23.w: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these [were] the sons of Joktan.

28.w: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.

29.w: These [are] their genealogies: The firstborn of Ishmael Nebaioth, and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

30.w: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,

31.w: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These were the sons of Ishmael.

32.w: And the sons born to Keturah concubine of Abraham: Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.

33.w: And the sons of Midian: Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abidah, and Eldaah. All these [were] the sons of Keturah.

34.w: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.

35.w: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.

36.w: And the sons of Eliphaz: Teman, and Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, [and] Kenaz; and [by] Timna, Amalek.

37.w: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

38.w: And the sons of Seir: Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan.

39.w: And the sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam, and the sister of Lotan [was] Timna.

40.w: The sons of Shobal: Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.

41.w: The sons of Anah: Dishon. And the sons of Dishon: Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

42.w: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, and Zaavan, [and] Akan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

43.w: And these [were] the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before the face of the reigning of a king over the sons of Israel: Bela son of Beor, and the name of his city [was] Dinhabah.

44.w: And Bela died, and Jobab son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.

45.w: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanite reigned in his place.

46.w: And Husham died, and Hadad son of Bedad reigned in his place, who struck down Midian in the field of Moab. And the name of his city [was] Avith.

47.w: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

48.w: And Samlah died, and Saul from Rehoboth of the River reigned in his place.

49.w: And Saul died, and Baal-hanan son of Achbor reigned in his place.

50.w: [And] Baal-hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place. And the name of his city [was] Pau, and the name of His wife [was] Mehetabel daughter of Matred, daughter of Me-zahab.

51.w: And Hadad died. And the chiefs of Edom were: Chief Timna, Chief Alvah, Chief Jetheth,

52.w: Chief Oholibamah, Chief Elah, Chief Pinon,

53.w: Chief Kenaz, Chief Teman, Chief Mibzar,

54.w: Chief Magdiel, [and] Chief Iram. These [were] the chiefs of Edom.
